You can place your own artwork directly onto the template, or send us your logo, color palette, and regulatory copy for layout assistance before pre-press verification.

sections.heading: Price factors & ordering steps

sections.heading: Products and container sizes
sections.body: We engineer custom beauty subscription boxes for tubes, glass bottles, jars, compacts, and multi-product sets. Whether you pack 10ml travel sizes, 30ml and 50ml standard retail formats, or 100ml family sizes, the internal dimensions are sized with exact clearances so the container sits upright and secure without rattling.

sections.heading: Customization & finishing options
sections.body: Elevate your shelf presence with full-color CMYK and Pantone exterior printing, interior flood coating, and clear product windows. Choose between soft-touch velvet matte lamination or high-gloss coatings, and accent your logo with hot foil stamping (metallic gold, silver, rose gold), blind embossing, or spot UV varnish.

sections.heading: Help with sizing & measurements
sections.body: To get a precise fit, measure your container with the cap, pump, or dropper fitted: measure maximum outside diameter or width, depth, and overall height. Add 1.5mm to 2mm clearance on each dimension. Alternatively, you can mail us a physical sample of your bottle or component, and our packaging engineers will build the dieline to measure.

sections.heading: Artwork dielines & design support
sections.body: We supply 1:1 scale vector dieline templates (PDF / Illustrator) indicating fold creases, glue flaps, trim cuts, and bleed zones. You can place your own artwork directly onto the template, or send us your logo, color palette, and regulatory copy for layout assistance before pre-press verification.

sections.heading: Price factors & ordering steps
sections.body: Your quote is determined by box dimensions, chosen paperboard caliper (16pt–24pt SBS paperboard), order volume, and optional finishes like foil or windows. After you request a quote, we confirm specifications, provide a digital 3D proof, produce an optional pre-production sample, and manufacture your complete run with tracked delivery.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for beauty subscription boxes?
faqs.a: Our standard production runs begin at 250 to 500 units for custom printed folding cartons, with volume pricing tiers at 1,000, 2,500, 5,000, and 10,000+ units.

faqs.q: Can I get a physical sample of my beauty subscription boxes before mass production?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer plain structural white samples to test container fit, as well as full digital color printed proofs before the full production run begins.

faqs.q: How long does production and delivery take?
faqs.a: Standard production typically takes 8 to 12 business days following final artwork proof approval. Expedited turnaround is available upon request.
